record.what_it_does: Open-source CLI and Node library that renders Mermaid diagram text to SVG, PNG or PDF.
record.auth_notes: No hosted service and no authentication. It runs locally (npm, Docker or Podman), so there are no credentials.
record.access_notes: The tool is MIT-licensed and free to install. It has no hosted public API, so there are no credentials to obtain.
record.api_breadth_notes: One function: render a Mermaid definition to SVG, PNG or PDF. This is the `mmdc` CLI plus a Node `run` function, which the README says is not covered by semver. It also handles Mermaid code blocks in Markdown files.
record.mcp_notes: I found no MCP server published by mermaid-js. Community servers exist: @peng-shawn/mermaid-mcp-server, mcp-mermaid (hustcc) and mermaid-render-mcp. Some of them wrap mermaid-cli. A Stacklok registry page labels one listing "Official", but I could not tell which organization owns it.
record.blocker_notes: This is a local CLI with no hosted API or user accounts. Composio would have to run the renderer itself, using headless Chromium via Puppeteer, as a hosted utility. It is not an end-user-authenticated integration.

evidence.quote: takes a Mermaid definition file and outputs an SVG, PNG, or PDF
the NodeJS API is not covered by semver

record.needs_human: The mermaid-js org page was not checked for an official MCP server. The Stacklok "Official" listing was unverified. The MCP npm quote comes from a search-result title, because I did not open that page.
